cases.disposition_reason: Holla parity-disk-scan at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion and HOLLA_NO_HISTORY=1 opens the finder. Pasting Analyze disk usage selects that catalog row and Enter launches Launch::Disk of the scenario cwd. The page shows Disk › Usage and Disk usage · ~/work/data, and the meter is 611 of 926 GB. /Volumes/Backup and 842 of 926 GB are absent. Esc returns to the finder, which still shows the catalog label and does not show Disk › Usage or Quit holla. App::finish sends Ctrl+Q and exits 0.
cases.entry_path: parity-disk-scan finder, paste Analyze disk usage, Enter
cases.return_path: Esc back to the finder, then Ctrl+Q

cases.disposition_reason: Opening Analyze disk usage shows Disk › Usage while the scan is still running. x on that scanning screen sets Scan cancelled · the partial tree stays and is labelled partial and the banner partial · scan cancelled. The checkpoint does not contain scan complete. The meter stays 611 of 926 GB, and 842 of 926 and /Volumes/Backup are absent. The cancelled tree is captured at 120×40 and then at 80×24, and the narrow shot is taken before the terminal returns to 120×40. Busy rows keep a spinner glyph; reduced motion still advances the simulated clock, so the capture waits until a resize paints the first frame. r then shows Rescanning · cached hints stay until live sizes arrive. The finished banner is prefixed by 2 unreadable · grant Full Disk Access to include them and contains scan complete and live · complete. Moving the cursor shows permission denied on locked, dataless and evicted to iCloud · never materialised by the scan on cloud, and the revealed media detail does not contain hint only. Disk overview shows cached sizes are hints with their age · Enter analyses live, with unscanned rows, and does not show sparse.img, scan complete, or the word stale. Enter on ~/Documents starts a new scan titled Disk usage · ~/Documents. The previous title Disk usage · ~/work/data and sparse.img are absent. The shell status chip still paints the scenario cwd ~/work/data, so that path is not this page's scan root. Quit holla is not drawn before Ctrl+Q.
cases.action_sequence: Start a scan, observe progress and partial data, cancel one scan, and complete another. Change the scan root.
cases.expected_results: Cancellation does not show a completed total. A stale result is labelled when the root changes.
cases.forbidden_effects: A cancelled scan shows the completed byte total as final.

cases.disposition_reason: The scan journey is the parity-disk-scan fixture. The visible identities are ~/work/data, 611 of 926 GB, and sparse.img. disk-cleanup identities 842 of 926 GB, /Volumes/Backup, and evicted.bin are absent.
cases.action_sequence: Launch the application with scenario parity-disk-scan and exercise the surface owned by H05.scan.
cases.expected_results: The visible fixture data belongs to parity-disk-scan.
cases.forbidden_effects: The journey asserts a different scenario's identities.

cases.disposition_reason: --scenario disk-cleanup pushes the disk page immediately at ~/work. The page shows Disk › Usage, Disk usage · ~/work, 842 of 926 GB, and /Volumes/Backup. sparse.img, evicted.bin, and 611 of 926 are absent. Cleanup gates are not driven.
cases.action_sequence: Launch the application with scenario disk-cleanup and exercise the surface owned by H05.scan.
cases.expected_results: The visible fixture data belongs to disk-cleanup.
cases.forbidden_effects: The journey asserts a different scenario's identities.
